description: This file contains Go source code for a package named 'protobuf' that provides functions for rewriting and manipulating Go AST files, particularly for protobuf code generation. It includes functions for rewriting files, handling imports, updating struct tags, and processing protobuf-related code transformations.

methods.name: rewriteFile
methods.description: Rewrites a Go source file by applying a provided rewrite function to its AST.

methods.name: RewriteGeneratedGogoProtobufFile
methods.description: Rewrites a protobuf-generated Go file, transforming optional methods, imports, and removing certain types based on provided functions.

methods.name: rewriteGogoSortImport
methods.description: Rewrites import of 'github.com/gogo/protobuf/sortkeys' to 'sort' and returns the original alias.

methods.name: rewriteGogoSort
methods.description: Replaces usage of the oldSortImport package with newSortImport in function declarations.

methods.name: dropUnusedGo
methods.description: Determines if a top-level declaration should be dropped based on its type and name.

methods.name: dropExistingTypeDeclarations
methods.description: Removes type declarations for which the extract function returns true.

methods.name: dropEmptyImportDeclarations
methods.description: Removes import declarations that are no-ops or only contain blank identifier imports.

methods.name: RewriteTypesWithProtobufStructTags
methods.description: Updates struct tags in a Go file to include protobuf tags based on provided mapping.

methods.name: updateStructTags
methods.description: Updates struct field tags in AST nodes with new tags from a provided map.
